definition: Match sign(predicted Day3 - predicted Day1) with sign(actual Day3 - actual Day1). Rising/declining/exact endpoint-flat. Day1/Day3 are forecast horizons t+1/t+3, not currentday t.
supplementary_definition: Both signs Day2-Day1 and Day3-Day2 must match actual signs.
count_metrics: MAE/RMSE retained for level errors. Direction metric is primary for direction, not a replacement for the entire trajectory task.
timing: Evaluation emphasis revised after inspecting 2021 results, exploratory and not a prespecified independent confirmation.
selection: No new feature, model or window selection based on this change.
